name: November to May Promo
description:
November to May PROMO at CAMP ENOKI  
 Your Own Private Resort with Pool – Exclusive for Your Group Only!

 Overnight Stay
 Check-in: 2:00 PM
 Check-out: 12:00 NN (next day)

 ONLY ₱9,500 per night
 NEW & IMPROVED to serve you better:
 Night Watch INCLUDED (10:00 PM – 6:00 AM)
 FREE Videoke

 Comfortable for up to 21 guests (recommended)
 Can accommodate up to 25 guests depending on body size and group preference. Comfort is not guaranteed.

 SLEEP SOUNDLY – NIGHT WATCH INCLUDED
Your peace of mind while you sleep is our priority.
 1 night watch on duty from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM
 Regular rounds of the property while your group rests
 CCTV-monitored premises
 For extra peace of mind, please keep phones, gadgets and valuables inside the lockable teepee huts. Guests remain responsible for their personal belongings.

 Why celebrate at Camp Enoki?
 Cool holiday weather
 Cozy glamping vibes
 Perfect for Christmas & New Year family reunions, barkada & company outings
 Peaceful surroundings
 Perfect for families, barkada, couples, WFH & pet lovers

 Enjoy the entire property exclusively for your group!
 No sharing with other guests
 Peaceful and private
 Relax at your own pace

 Just 1 minute from the beach & river
 Beach access (weather permitting)
 The beach may occasionally be under a red flag, which means swimming is temporarily not allowed for everyone's safety. The good news is you'll still have exclusive access to our private swimming pool, so your getaway continues rain or shine!
 River access (subject to weather conditions)

 PRIVATE DIPPING POOL
 Fresh water every stay
 No chlorine. No harsh chemicals.
 Safe for kids and pets
 Gentle on the skin

 ACCOMMODATIONS
 3 Air-Conditioned Teepee Huts (lockable)
• Good for 3 to 4 guests each (depending on body size)
• 4-inch foam mattress
• Blanket, pillow & bed cover included

 2 Fan Teepee Huts (lockable)
• Good for 3 to 4 guests each (depending on body size)
• 4-inch foam mattress
• Blanket, pillow & bed cover included

 2 Large Camping Tents (available when needed)
• Good for 4-6 guests each
• With Uratex foam
***Tents are not secured unlike the teepee hut so make sure to exercise necessary care with your belongings. 

 FREE AMENITIES
 Night watch (10:00 PM – 6:00 AM)
 Videoke
 Beach & river access
 Outdoor showers
 Outdoor dining area
 FREE Wi-Fi (Converge Fiber 300 Mbps)
 Perfect for freelancers, WFH & digital nomads
 FREE parking (up to 2 cars)
 FREE 1 gallon of drinking water
 FREE use of griller
 FREE microwave oven & electric kettle
 Gas stove available (LPG only ₱200)
 Pet-friendly
 Hammocks, beach chairs, tables & tents

 Please Note
Our teepee huts remain comfortable even during heavy rain. However, our camping tents are traditional outdoor tents, so during heavy rain and strong winds, guests staying in the tents may experience minor inconveniences such as moisture or a few water drips. Tents cannot be locked, so please keep valuables inside the teepee huts. We regularly maintain our camping equipment and will gladly assist whenever needed.

 Optional Activities
 ATV & UTV Rental
 Banana Boat
